threads.label: The sister's last minutes, told backward
The forensic lab, processing physical evidence

events.text: Dietz starts canvassing the docks with only a photo and a name.
Dietz's sister looks up one last time, already knowing the man in the doorway.
Amara pulls the dock's registry logs from the night in question.
He finds a witness who remembers the doorway.
A few minutes earlier, she had bolted the door, certain she'd locked him out for good.
He cross-references the registry against a name Corvin radioed in.
He corners the witness for a straight answer about the doorway.
It began the moment the man first knocked, the door still unbolted behind her.
He matches the name to an arrest record and radios Corvin the address.
Dietz reaches the address and finally learns what happened in that doorway.
He finds a bloodstained cloth tucked behind a piling near the address.
He bags the cloth himself and drives it to the forensic lab.
He waits at the lab through the following hour for preliminary results.
He gets confirmation from the lab and matches it to the arrest record Voss found.
Dietz closes the case file, walking back past the docks where it started.
Amara visits the address after radioing Dietz, beginning an independent canvass of the neighbors.
He finds a neighbor who saw someone dispose of a bloodstained cloth near the scene.
He sends word to the forensic lab to prioritize the cloth evidence.
He reviews the lab's chain-of-custody paperwork while waiting on results.
He receives the lab's confirmation and cross-checks it against the arrest record.
Amara closes the loop with Dietz, confirming the match.
Forensic techs are dispatched to the docks to begin processing the scene.
Techs lift a partial fingerprint from the doorway railing.
Techs bag trace fibers snagged on the doorframe, cataloguing them over the next two hours.
The lab finishes cataloguing the fiber evidence and preps the intake bay for what's still coming in from the scene.
The lab receives Amara's rush request just as Dietz's cloth arrives, and begins prioritized processing that runs through the following hour.
The lab logs the cloth into evidence and cross-references the partial print against the arrest record.
The lab runs comparative fiber and bloodstain analysis on the cloth, a process spanning the next hour and a half.
The lab issues a preliminary report confirming the print, fibers, and cloth all trace to the same address.
The lab archives the physical evidence as the case closes.
Moments before that, she hears a second knock, softer than the first.

events.time_expr: just before, in the same held breath
events.text: Just before, she presses her palm flat against the door, listening.
Earlier than that, she'd argued with him through the door, telling him to leave.
Earlier still, she'd watched him approach from the window, recognizing his coat.
Earlier that evening, she'd unlocked the door for the first time in weeks, half-hoping he'd come.

events.time_expr: earlier still, before any of it
events.text: Earlier still, before any of it, she'd read his old letter and decided to wait by the door.
